get.description:
List the agents Ray has.

Agents are defined in code (ADR-0005); this reports the registry plus the
user's enable/disable state, not database-defined behaviour.

A memory the user wrote themselves, embedded immediately so it is retrievable
on the very next turn.

Semantic search, ranked exactly as retrieval ranks — this is the debugging
surface for "why does Ray keep bringing that up?".

schema.title: Response Search Memories Memory Search Get

Unimportant, never-retrieved conversation memories. Ray flags; the user
decides — nothing here is deleted automatically (ADR-0013).

get.description:
Return a complete, user-owned snapshot of Ray data.

Secrets are not included: ``credentials_reference`` is the *name* of an env var
or keyring key, not the value (docs/12).

AgentRead.title: AgentRead
AgentRead.description: An entry in the code-side agent registry, plus its runtime state.

ApprovalDecision.title: ApprovalDecision
ApprovalDecision.description:
``always_allow`` records a standing decision alongside this one approval, which
is what keeps the gate from becoming click fatigue (ADR-0014).

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description:
One turn. Modality is part of the request because a spoken answer is a
different answer, not a different renderer (ADR-0009).

DiagnosticsResponse.title: DiagnosticsResponse
DiagnosticsResponse.description: Detailed self-diagnosis for the UI /settings page and CLI.

ExportSnapshot.title: ExportSnapshot
ExportSnapshot.description: A complete, user-owned data export (docs/12, docs/13).

MemoryCategorySettings.title: MemoryCategorySettings
MemoryCategorySettings.description: Which categories the user has switched off. Everything else is on.

MemoryScored.title: MemoryScored
MemoryScored.description:
A retrieval result with the numbers behind it, so a surprising memory can be
explained rather than guessed at.

ProviderStatus.title: ProviderStatus
ProviderStatus.description: One link in the provider chain, and why it is or is not usable.

ToolInvocationRead.title: ToolInvocationRead
ToolInvocationRead.description:
One tool call. The approval card is rendered from ``payload`` (ADR-0014), so
the user approves the action that will actually run.

VoiceCapabilities.title: VoiceCapabilities
VoiceCapabilities.description:
What the client may offer right now.

The frontend renders its voice controls from this rather than hardcoding a
phase, so upgrading the backend from browser to local speech needs no frontend
change (ADR-0009).
